headline_marked: [[Mahalaya marks start]] of Durga Puja festivities in Bangladesh
headline: Mahalaya marks start of Durga Puja festivities in Bangladesh
summary: Devotees gathered at Dhakeshwari National Temple and Banani ground for Chandi recitation and rituals, welcoming the Goddess Durga and the beginning of the festive season.
details: Mahalaya, marking the auspicious beginning of Sharodiya Durgotsav, was celebrated today with devotion across Bangladesh. Devotees gathered at temples, reciting Chandi hymns and performing rituals to welcome Goddess Durga.

At the Dhakeshwari National Temple in Dhaka, special prayers and 'pitritarpan' (rituals for ancestors) were held from early morning. The event signifies the start of the 'Debipaksha' and the final countdown to Durga Puja.

Thousands of devotees flocked to the Dhakeshwari temple grounds, praying for the destruction of evil forces and seeking blessings for peace and prosperity. The ceremony marks the beginning of preparations for the six-day Durga Puja festival.
The Indian High Commissioner to Dhaka, Dinesh Chandra, attended the Dhakeshwari event, extending greetings and wishing for lasting peace and well-being for all humanity.

In a separate ceremony at Banani ground, organized by the Gulshan-Banani Sarbojanin Puja Foundation, Mahbubul Haque Shakil, the Prime Minister's Education Advisor, was the chief guest. He emphasized unity and national identity, stating that 'Bangladeshi' is the primary identity for all citizens.
Shakil also highlighted the government's commitment to ensuring a peaceful Durga Puja celebration, noting increased financial grants and allocations for puja mandaps across the country.
The Banani event was also attended by the Indian Deputy High Commissioner to Dhaka, Pawan Kumar Banej, and leaders of the Puja Udjapon Committee.

headline_marked: Trump [[lifts sanctions on Russian fuel]] to lower global diesel prices
headline: Trump lifts sanctions on Russian fuel to lower global diesel prices
summary: The US administration temporarily eased sanctions on Russian diesel to combat record-high fuel costs ahead of the November 3 congressional elections.
details: President Donald Trump announced that Russia will immediately supply over 300,000 metric tons of diesel to US and global markets to lower fuel prices. To facilitate this, the US administration has temporarily lifted sanctions on Russian fuel that were originally intended to deprive Moscow of war revenues.

The deal comes as diesel prices, essential for agriculture and trucking, hit near-record highs. US diesel futures fell nearly 5 percent following the announcement, though analysts warn the volume may be insufficient for a sustained price drop.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky criticized the move as a 'weak decision,' arguing that providing revenue to Vladimir Putin will only lead to further terror in Ukraine.
US lawmakers, including Republican Representative Don Bacon, also condemned the deal, stating that the US should be squeezing Putin's war machine rather than rewarding a dictator.

The US Treasury Department has issued a license allowing the importation of Russian diesel until April 7. Trump stated that Russia would supply an additional 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons shortly after.
Global fuel supplies have been severely strained by conflicts in Ukraine and Iran, with average US diesel prices reaching $6.28 a gallon last Thursday.
Trump also plans to issue a directive to US department heads to find more ways to control prices, potentially using the Cold War-era Defense Production Act to increase domestic oil and fuel output.

The US Treasury Department has issued a license allowing the importation of Russian diesel until April 7. Trump stated that Russia would supply an additional 500,000 tons in November and 1 million tons shortly after.
